answer: The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in ocean, expire in mirror, and lantern lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 116 aliases as a result needs 116 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 183 dollars in locked collateral and another 4 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
